easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Teleportation Circle's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Teleportation Circle's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.
